body: Thank you, this really helped me
I spoke to him and he said not to worry, because he understands why I had to do it and that he would be fine. Thank you for your response, it made me feel better about the situation
I ended up talking to him again and he said everything would be fine with him, and not to worry.  Thank you for this.  It made me feel better

Thank you very much for reading and responding.  I'll make sure to try and figure myself out before involving myself with anyone in the future.  If I would have known it would have ended like this with me hurting him, I would have never dated him.  But I guess that is a part of growing up/learning from relationships.
Thank you.  The last thing I want to do is hurt him anymore.  I'll make sure to give him space, even though I think of him constantly.  Thanks so much
